name: Rod of Ready-Making
body:
Price 15,000 gp; Aura moderate transmutation; CL 10; Weight 4 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This utilitarian metal rod, usually made of adamantine or iron, allows the user to equip or unequip and store a full set of armor and weapons. When fully armed, the user can use a standard action to store the equipped armor and weapons in the rod. Anytime thereafter, the user can use a standard action to retrieve the stored equipment. If the user is wearing a different set of weapons or armor, they are swapped for the stored set, and the new set is now stored. As a full round action, stored equipment can be ejected in a nicely stacked and folded fashion in an adjacent space.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 7,500 gp; Feats Craft Rod; Spells shrink item
